task: V5 ambient micro-motion: stove fire flicker

mechanism.self_attach: [RuntimeInitializeOnLoadMethod(AfterSceneLoad)] spawns a hidden DontDestroyOnLoad '~FlickerLightDriver'. Driver Update() throttles (Time.unscaledTime, every 1.0s) and runs FindObjectsByType<StoveEntity>, calling FlickerLight.EnsureOn for any stove without one. Picks up runtime/mid-game-built stoves within ~1s. No SceneSetup/BuildManager/stovePrefab edit.
mechanism.flicker: Additive child overlay GameObject 'FlameOverlay' parented to stove; reuses body sprite as flame silhouette, warm orange tint, sortingOrder = body+1. Pulses alpha (base 0.55 +/-0.18) and scale (1.0 +/-0.08) at ~4Hz using two detuned Perlin-noise streams + per-instance random phase seeds -> organic, out-of-sync, NOT a strobe. Body root SpriteRenderer NEVER recolored (tint contract untouched); OnDisable just fades overlay to alpha 0, nothing on body to restore.
mechanism.lit_gating: IsLit() = stove.MealsAvailable > 0 || stove.CanCookOne(). Lit -> full flame; not lit -> faint ember (alpha 0.10). No explicit isLit on StoveEntity, so heuristic used.

bug_firewall.#9_runInBackground: No new always-on background timer. Driver uses Time-based throttle inside Update (no WaitForSeconds heartbeat). AutoScreenshotter still owns Application.runInBackground for CLI QA.
bug_firewall.alloc: Driver uses a static reused List scratch + cached scan interval; no per-frame allocations in flicker Update.
